preconditions.description: The number of computers n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of cables m must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in cables)
preconditions.description: Each cable must connect two valid computer indices.

postconditions.description: The total number of cables p in the final scheme must be at least the original number of cables m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= n and 1 <= di <= n for ci, di in output_cables)
postconditions.description: Each output cable must connect two valid computer indices.
The number of output cables must match the total number of cables p.
For each computer, the number of outgoing cables must be even, ensuring that all cables can be grouped into pairs with the same direction of information flow.
postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for ci, di in output_cables if ci == i) % 2 == 0 for i in range(1, n + 1))

postconditions.description: All original cables must be included in the output in some direction.
postconditions.expression: all((ai, bi) in output_cables or (bi, ai) in output_cables for ai, bi in cables)
